spotangels-2040-cornwall-2026-10-05.title: User-supplied SpotAngels curb entry for 2040 Cornwall Avenue

geometryNote: Approximate sign-bounded curb sections traced from the supplied photographs and Street View landmarks. The sign boundary at 2268 Cornwall Avenue is used as the split; endpoints are not surveyed.
restrictionNote: Current user photographs show a morning no-parking restriction on the building-side curb west of 2268 Cornwall and a permit-only sign pointing east from that boundary. The City default for unsigned public curb parking is a three-hour limit from 8am to 6pm; always follow the sign beside the space.

sections.splitBoundaryNote: The user-supplied map exposes the rule at 2040 Cornwall but not the sign arrows or the next boundary. This is intentionally a short 20 m candidate slice centered on the pin, not a block-wide inference.

spotChecks.finding: The linked SpotAngels entry identifies 2040 Cornwall Avenue as free outside a No Stopping period, Monday–Friday, 7am–9:30am. August 2024 Street View at the pin shows a curb sign but its text is not readable enough to establish its direction or extent.
spotChecks.scope: Third-party map claim retained at pin precision only. Follow the posted sign.
